title: Mass file rename in progress on WKS-HR-014
description: 1,842 files renamed to a .nocturnelock extension in sixty seconds. The process doing it is onedrivesync.exe, running from AppData.

title: Volume shadow copies deleted
description: vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet executed on WKS-HR-014, fourteen seconds before encryption began. Local recovery points are gone.

title: Mass file rename detections on four more hosts
description: The same detection has now fired on WKS-HR-015, WKS-FIN-003, WKS-ADM-021 and the shared file server FS-SHARED-01. 47,000 files affected across the estate.

title: Scheduled antivirus scan completed
description: Routine scheduled scan on WKS-FIN-003 completed with no detections. Expected daily activity.

title: Resolution of a previously blocked command-and-control domain
description: WKS-HR-014 resolved update-cdn.paylo4d.example and downloaded 1.8 MB from it at 07:39 - three minutes before encryption started. This domain was blocked at the proxy after incident INC-2025-0311 on 11 March, but never at DNS or the firewall.
